headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment Certification on Listed Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited certified to NSE that it has made timely interest payments on its publicly issued Secured and Unsecured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures, in compliance with SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015.
detail: Under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, Regulation 57, listed companies must certify timely payment of interest on secured and unsecured redeemable non-convertible debentures issued via public offer. Sammaan Capital's June 2026 certification indicates active debt servicing and compliance with statutory payment obligations. The intimation was filed with NSE on 25 June 2026 and covers both secured and unsecured debt tranches.
